win.shell.agentUsageDescription: Follow plan limits, tokens, API value and the work in progress of Claude, Codex, OpenCode and GitHub Copilot.
win.shell.cleanerDescription: Clear caches, temporary files and other junk
win.shell.packageManagerDescription: Search, install, update and remove apps with winget
win.shell.shelfDescription: Park files, text and links while you drag them
win.shell.keepAwakeDescription: Keep the PC awake on demand
win.shell.quitProtectionDescription: Protects Alt+F4, Ctrl+Q and Ctrl+W from accidental presses
win.shell.presetEssentialsDescription: Screenshots, screen recording, the cleaner, the volume mixer, the system monitor and keep awake.
win.shell.presetCreatorDescription: Screenshots, recording, text and colour capture, camera preview, media tools, clipboard, shelf and scratchpad.
win.shell.explainNotifications: Lets the app notify you about alerts you turned on.
win.shell.explainCamera: Lets camera preview show your camera.
win.shell.explainMicrophone: Lets screen recording capture your voice.
win.shell.explainAdministrator: Some parts work only when the app runs as administrator: reading CPU temperatures, cleaning system folders and controlling windows of apps that run as administrator.
win.shell.trayIconCaption: Choose the icon the app shows in the system tray.
win.shell.trayPinGuideBody: Windows puts new icons in the hidden icons area. Drag the icon from there onto the taskbar, or turn it on in Settings › Personalization › Taskbar › Other system tray icons.
win.shell.panelLayoutIntro: Click the app's icon in the system tray to open the panel. Its tabs appear in this order.
win.shell.panelLayoutCaption: Drag to reorder. Switch off anything you don't need.
win.shell.launchAtLoginCaption: Opens by itself every time you sign in to Windows.
win.shell.launchAtLoginDisabledByUser: Turned off in Windows Settings › Apps › Startup. Turn it back on there.
win.shell.appearanceCaption: Applies to the app's own windows and panels, not to the whole PC.
win.shell.translucencyCaption: Uses Mica and Acrylic on Windows 11 when transparency effects are on.
win.shell.shortcutsIntro: Edit every global shortcut from the features installed on this PC. Inactive shortcuts stay saved but do not run.
win.shell.shortcutReserved: Windows uses this combination. Choose another one.
win.shell.shortcutRegistrationFailed: Windows or another app already uses this shortcut. Choose another one.
win.shell.shortcutInvalid: Use Ctrl, Alt or Win with a key, or a function key.
win.shell.shortcutRecordingCaption: Press the new shortcut. Esc cancels.
win.shell.shortcutUsedByFormat: This shortcut is already used by %@.
win.shell.backupDescription: Take your setup to another PC: export every preference to a file and import it there. Your scratchpad notes, clipboard history and shelf items never leave this PC.
win.shell.backupInvalid: This file is not a valid settings backup.
win.shell.uninstallSelfCaption: Opens Windows Settings › Apps, where you can uninstall it. Your settings stay in your profile until you delete them.
win.shell.dataFolderCaption: Settings, notes and caches live here.
win.shell.aboutDescription: A Windows port of a free, open-source collection of everyday utilities: capture, system monitor, cleaner, clipboard, audio and more. Local-first, with no account and no telemetry.
hub.presetsCaption: One click sets the app up for how you use your PC. Everything else stays one click away.
hub.monitorAllOffNote: With everything off, the Monitor leaves the panel and the tray.
hub.permissionsIntro: What each Windows capability does and which features use it. Other access is requested only when you use it.
Strings.keepAwakeRightClickToggle: Right-click the tray icon to toggle Keep Awake
Strings.obStepWelcomeBody: A discreet system tray utility that makes everyday Windows more practical.
win.shell.obBullet1Body: Screenshots with an editor, screen recordings with automatic zooms, text and colours from anywhere on screen.
win.shell.obBullet2Title: A clear view of the system
win.shell.obBullet2Body: Processor, graphics, memory, disks, network and battery at a glance, with alerts when something needs attention.
win.shell.obBullet3Body: Cleaner, uninstaller, app updates, clipboard history, volume mixer and more, each one optional.
win.shell.obDoneBodyFormat: %@ is already looking after your PC.
win.shell.obDoneHint: Look for the icon in the system tray, at the bottom right of the screen. If you don't see it, it is in the hidden icons area: open the ^ arrow and drag it onto the taskbar.
backup.importConfirmBody: Your current settings are replaced by the file’s and the app restarts. Nothing else on this PC is touched.
